name: Amine oxides, C12-14-alkyldimethyl
description: Amine oxides, C12-14-alkyldimethyl (CAS 308062-28-4 ) are amphoteric surfactants derived from coconut-chain fatty amines. They function as foam boosters, viscosity builders, and conditioning agents across detergent and personal care formulations. In household and industrial cleaning products, they stabilize and enhance foam in dish soaps, hard surface cleaners, and all-purpose detergents while improving soil suspension. These versatile surfactants are essential for high-performance cleaning. Personal care formulators incorporate them into shampoos and body washes to boost lather and increase viscosity. They also deliver mild conditioning to hair and skin, making them a staple in premium cosmetic manufacturing. In textile processing, these oxides support emulsification and fiber lubrication during wet finishing operations. Their chemical stability ensures consistent performance across various industrial textile treatment processes. Industrial degreasers and janitorial concentrates rely on their compatibility with anionic surfactants to boost cleaning performance. They help maintain formulation stability even in concentrated chemical environments. The product is typically supplied as an aqueous solution at 30% active content. Standard commercial grades are available for personal care and household cleaning applications to meet diverse manufacturing needs. Some suppliers offer low-color, low-odor variants suited to premium formulations. Industrial and technical grades are also available for high-volume cleaning and specialized process applications across the chemical industry.
